svg.title: MV.tech Safari pinned-tab mask
svg.desc: Single-colour silhouette of the MV.tech monogram from 00_Master_Vector/mvtech-monogram-mono-black.svg, at the master's full 1200 x 694.36 artwork box so the V's rounded bottom arc is not clipped. Safari uses this as an alpha mask and tints it with the mask-icon color attribute. No background. Do not recolour or separate the dot.
